_comment: Game profiles. A profile only selects tools and records facts/gaps for one game; it never changes other games. 'verified' lists what was actually run; 'gaps' what is known missing.

wuwa.name: Wuthering Waves
wuwa.capture_notes: RenderDoc D3D11 captures exist (user-made, 590MB-2.1GB). WWMI is the 3DMigoto route.
verified: RenderDoc D3D11 capture -> UE 5.8 and Unity 6 scene (bridge scene, 19k instances, camera matched)

whole-library SourceProbe dump-index (41,133 SM_ packages / 157,691 sections) -> 96% of scene instances carry their source asset name in UE and Unity (frame 3422: 386/681 draws; frame 61250: 592/1017 draws)
second capture (frame 61250) reconstructed end-to-end: VP fit 0.96, UE import 851 meshes / 26,944 instances, screenshot aligns with the reference frame
identify reproduces 6 independently established frame-61250 source matches (same object / LOD / section)
gaps: transparent / water / foliage passes not exported
skinned/wind meshes baked at capture pose
instanced draws that use one section of a larger array mesh stay unmatched (whole-mesh identity only)
~11k SM_ packages have no rendered LOD data in the mounted pak view (StandaloneBodySetups etc.) and cannot be indexed
key handling stays inside the user's SourceProbe

user's earlier UE reconstruction used AnimeStudio exports (verified-prior)

world/camera placement needs ZZZ VS cbuffer decoding (not done)
skinning pose is whatever was dumped
